import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix label variants in species and island
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (with commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Keep sex as-is; missing stays NaN (do not guess)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace({'nan': pd.NA, 'None': pd.NA, '': pd.NA})
    # Ensure sex is proper categorical/text with NaN preserved
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].where(df['sex'].notna() & (df['sex'] != ''), pd.NA)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Drop missing sex keys as instructed
    sub = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    means = sub.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    result = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in means.items()}
    return result
